## Summary

I investigated ticket T-2009 and identified the root cause of the pricing-engine crash loop. The pods are experiencing **node-level disk space pressure** that is triggering kubelet eviction. Since the Deployment continuously attempts to replace evicted pods, they enter a CrashLoopBackOff state. This explains why the crash occurred suddenly at a specific time (around 2pm) without any recent code changes or deployments.

The fix involves checking node disk usage, freeing up disk space through garbage collection of images and dead containers, and monitoring disk usage going forward to prevent recurrence. The Deployment will automatically recover once disk pressure is resolved.
